summary.text: Norma Hernandez is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 77, in office since January 2023, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A city planner and former Triton College trustee, she holds a master's degree in urban planning and policy from the University of Illinois at Chicago.

paragraphs.text: Norma Hernandez was born in Melrose Park, Illinois.

She earned an associate degree from Triton College in 2013, a bachelor's degree in social work from Aurora University in 2017, and a master's degree in urban planning and policy from the University of Illinois at Chicago in 2019.

Her career experience includes working as an urban planner with the UIC Great Cities Institute, an intern with the City of Chicago Department of Planning and Development, and a child welfare specialist with Youth Outreach Services, and she served on the Triton College Board of Trustees.
Hernandez assumed office in the Illinois House on January 11, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Adoption & Child Welfare, Appropriations-Health and Human Services, Appropriations - Pensions and Personnel, Energy & Environment, House Higher Education, and Transportation: Regulation, Roads & Bridges committees, and as vice-chair of the Museum, Arts, Culture, and Entertainment Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Anthony Airdo (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
